abstract: We show that credit constraints significantly increase the risk that firms are infiltrated by organized crime, defined as the covert involvement of criminal organizations in corporate decision-making. Using confidential data on criminal investigations, credit ratings, and loan histories for the universe of Italian firms, we find that a downgrade to substandard credit status reduces credit availability by 30% over five years and increases the probability of infiltration by 5%, relative to comparable firms. A local randomization design comparing firms just above and below the downgrade threshold confirms this result. The effect is pervasive across sectors and regions, but particularly strong in real estate, where the probability of infiltration rises by 10% following a downgrade. Infiltrated firms also display higher survival rates than other downgraded firms, despite similar declines in employment and revenues. These findings suggest that organized crime can serve as a financial backstop — sustaining non-viable businesses and potentially redirecting their strategies to serve criminal interests.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，信贷约束显著增加了企业被有组织犯罪渗透的风险——即犯罪组织秘密介入企业决策。基于意大利全体企业的刑事调查、信用评级及贷款历史机密数据，我们发现：相较于可比企业，信用评级降至次级标准的企业五年内信贷可得性下降30%，被渗透概率上升5%。采用降级阈值附近企业的局部随机化设计验证了这一结果。该效应普遍存在于各行业与地区，但在房地产领域尤为显著——降级后该行业企业被渗透概率上升10%。尽管被渗透企业与其它降级企业同样面临就业与收入下滑，但其存活率更高。这些发现表明，有组织犯罪可充当财务后盾——维持无生存能力的企业运营，并可能引导其战略转向服务于犯罪利益。
title: A Loan You Can’t Refuse: Credit Rationing and Organized Crime Infiltration of Distressed Firms
title_zh: 无法拒绝的贷款：信贷配给与困境企业中有组织犯罪的渗透

abstract: We synthesize the literature on economic epidemiology, the interdisciplinary field that draws on the ideas and methods of economics to analyze individual behavior, aggregate disease dynamics, and public policy during infectious disease epidemics. We cover the main models of individual behavior during epidemics, related econometric evidence, and models of disease dynamics appropriate for the analysis of a range of infectious diseases. We outline modeling approaches to a range of control measures including nonpharmaceutical interventions such as stay–at–home mandates, quarantines, and sheltering, and pharmaceutical interventions such as vaccines and treatment. Last, we characterize different types of externalities and heterogeneities and discuss the targeting and implementation of policies through restrictions and incentives.
abstract_zh: 本文综合评述了经济流行病学领域的文献，这一跨学科领域借鉴经济学的思想与方法，分析传染病流行期间的个人行为、总体疾病动态及公共政策。我们涵盖流行病期间个人行为的主要模型、相关计量经济学证据，以及适用于分析多种传染病的疾病动态模型。我们概述了针对一系列防控措施的建模方法，包括非药物干预（如居家令、隔离和庇护）以及药物干预（如疫苗和治疗）。最后，我们刻画了不同类型的外部性与异质性，并讨论了通过限制措施与激励机制实施政策的目标定位与执行路径。
title: The Economics of Infectious Diseases

abstract: This paper investigates the role of administrative capacity in shaping procurement outcomes using rich Italian data on public works. We analyse the duration of the three main phases – planning, awarding, and execution – for observationally equivalent projects. First, we document substantial heterogeneity across contracting authorities: their fixed effects account for a sizeable share of the variation in procurement length, and delays tend to persist across all phases, pointing to structural differences in organizational capacity. These differences are strongly correlated with indicators of administrative quality. Second, we show that the identity of the procurement manager (RUP) matters, even within the same organization. Observable characteristics such as education or tenure explain only a limited fraction of the variation, highlighting the importance of unobservable factors such as tacit knowledge, effort, and managerial skills. Third, in the execution phase, both procuring authorities and firms play a crucial role: execution times are shorter when projects are awarded to more productive firms, and higher-ability managers are more likely to select such firms.
abstract_zh: 本文利用意大利公共工程的丰富数据，探究行政能力对采购结果的影响。我们分析了观察等价项目的三个主要阶段——规划、招标与执行——的持续时间。首先，我们记录了签约机构之间存在显著的异质性：其固定效应解释了采购时长变异的相当大一部分，且延误往往在所有阶段持续存在，这表明组织能力存在结构性差异。这些差异与行政质量指标高度相关。其次，我们证明采购经理（RUP）的身份至关重要，即使在同一个组织内部也是如此。教育背景或任职年限等可观测特征仅能解释有限比例的变异，这凸显了隐性知识、努力程度和管理技能等不可观测因素的重要性。第三，在执行阶段，采购机构与企业均发挥关键作用：当项目被授予生产率更高的企业时，执行时间更短，而能力更强的经理更倾向于选择此类企业。
title: Administrative Capacity in Public Procurement: Evidence and Mechanisms
title_zh: 公共采购中的行政能力：证据与机制

abstract: Exploiting three decades of detailed regional data for Germany, we find that when the Green Party is successful at the polls, local hazardous emissions decline. The level of political representation matters, too. Green politicians’ gaining influence at county level is followed largely by a decline in air pollutants that have an immediate adverse health effect. In contrast, when the Green party joins the state government, only greenhouse gas emissions that affect the welfare of future generations via climate change decline. The primary mechanism to achieve lower emissions appears to be a reduction in output, rather than more efficient energy use.
abstract_zh: 利用德国三十年来详尽的区域数据，我们发现当绿党在选举中获胜时，当地有害排放物会减少。政治代表程度同样重要。绿党政客在县级层面获得影响力后，主要伴随的是对健康有直接不利影响的空气污染物减少。相比之下，当绿党加入州政府时，只有通过气候变化影响后代福利的温室气体排放会减少。实现较低排放的主要机制似乎是产出减少，而非能源利用效率提升。

abstract: China’s unprecedented expansion of higher education in 1999, increased annual college enrollment from 1 million to 9.6 million by 2020. We trace the global ripple effects of that expansion by examining its impact on US graduate education and local economies surrounding college towns. Combining administrative data from China’s college admissions system and US visa data, we leverage the centralized quota system governing Chinese college admissions for identification and present three key findings. First, the expansion of Chinese undergraduate education drove graduate student flows to the US: every additional 100 college graduates in China led to 3.6 Chinese graduate students in the US. Second, Chinese master’s students generated positive spillovers, driving the birth of new master’s programs, and increasing the number of other international and American master's students, particularly in STEM fields. And third, the influx of international students supported local economies around college towns, raising job creation rates outside the universities, as well. Our findings highlight how domestic education policy in one country can reshape the academic and economic landscape of another through student migration and its broader spillovers.
abstract_zh: 中国1999年启动的高等教育史无前例的扩招，使年度大学招生人数从100万增至2020年的960万。我们通过考察该扩招对美国研究生教育及大学城周边地方经济的影响，追溯其全球涟漪效应。结合中国高考录取系统的行政数据与美国签证数据，我们利用中国大学招生的集中配额制度进行识别，得出三项核心发现：第一，中国本科教育的扩张推动了赴美研究生流动——中国每增加100名大学毕业生，美国便新增3.6名中国研究生；第二，中国硕士生产生正向溢出效应，催生新硕士项目设立，并带动其他国际学生及美国本土硕士生数量增长，尤其在STEM领域表现显著；第三，国际学生涌入为大学城周边地方经济提供支撑，同时提升了大学以外的就业岗位创造率。研究揭示了一国国内教育政策如何通过学生迁移及其广泛溢出效应，重塑另一国的学术与经济格局。

abstract: This paper examines whether increasing individuals’ awareness of their own confidence can influence financial behaviour. In a pre-registered online experiment with nearly 3,000 U.S. adults, we test the effects of a novel metacognitive intervention: personalised feedback on implicit confidence about one’s financial abilities, as measured by a custom Implicit Association Test (IAT), paired with an explanation of the importance of self-confidence in financial abilities. Treated participants show a significant reduction in “don’t know” responses on financial literacy tests and their performance in an incentivised investment task significantly improves: treated participants are less likely to make clearly dominated choices, more likely to select efficient allocations, and choose portfolios closer to the efficient frontier. These effects persist two weeks later in a follow-up survey with obfuscated framing. Heterogeneity analyses show stronger effects for females and for participants who understate their confidence (i.e. whose reported confidence is lower than what their IAT suggests). Keywords: Confidence, Confidence awareness, Personal finance, Financial literacy, Survey experiment.
abstract_zh: 本文探究提升个体对自身信心的认知是否会影响其金融行为。在一项针对近3000名美国成年人的预注册在线实验中，我们测试了一种新型元认知干预措施的效果：通过定制化内隐联想测验（IAT）测量个体对自身金融能力的内隐信心，并辅以关于金融能力自信心重要性的解释，向参与者提供个性化反馈。接受干预的参与者在金融素养测试中回答“不知道”的比例显著降低，且其在激励性投资任务中的表现显著改善：他们更少做出明显被支配的选择，更倾向于选择有效配置方案，并选择更接近有效前沿的投资组合。这些效应在两周后以模糊化框架进行的追踪调查中依然持续存在。异质性分析显示，该效应在女性参与者以及低估自身信心（即自我报告信心低于IAT测量结果）的参与者中更为显著。关键词：信心，信心认知，个人理财，金融素养，调查实验。
title: The Causal Effects of Confidence Awareness on Financial Literacy and Behaviour
title_zh: 信心意识对金融素养与行为的因果效应

abstract: In this paper, we revisit the question of how to manage financial crises using the framework proposed in Bianchi and Mendoza (2018). We show that this model economy exhibits a multiplicity of constrained-efficient equilibria, which arises because the private shadow value of collateral influences the forward-looking asset price. Among these equilibria, the specific one studied by Bianchi and Mendoza (2018) can be implemented using a tax/subsidy on debt alone. In that case, both the ex ante tax and ex post subsidy are quantitatively important for welfare under the optimal time-consistent policy. Limiting either component can lead to a welfare loss relative to the unregulated competitive equilibrium, highlighting the complementarity between crisis prevention and crisis resolution tools. We also show that, under certain conditions, all Pareto-dominant constrained-efficient equilibria entail the unconstrained allocation chosen by a social planner subject to the country budget constraint, and this allocation can be implemented with purely ex post policies.
abstract_zh: 本文利用Bianchi与Mendoza（2018）提出的分析框架，重新探讨了金融危机管理问题。研究表明，该模型经济中存在多重约束有效均衡，其根源在于抵押品的私人影子价值会影响前瞻性资产价格。在这些均衡中，Bianchi与Mendoza（2018）所研究的特定均衡可通过单一的债务税收/补贴政策实现。在此情形下，事前税收与事后补贴对于最优时间一致性政策下的福利水平均具有显著数量影响。若对任一政策工具施加限制，相较于无监管的竞争性均衡将导致福利损失，这凸显了危机预防工具与危机化解工具之间的互补性。此外，本文证明：在特定条件下，所有帕累托占优的约束有效均衡均等同于受国家预算约束的社会计划者所选择的非约束配置，且该配置可通过纯粹的事后政策实现。
title: Managing Financial Crises
